title: 法巴资管Catarina：AI采用放缓，是降温还是校准？
speaker: E. Catarina Bego

segments.en: So the big thing this week was not just the macro, but also what we heard from all these big AI labs in the US about slowing down the adoption of AI and really pacing the frontier. How should investors will be interpreting this?
segments.zh: 本周大事不只是宏观，还有美国大型AI实验室关于放缓AI采用、控制前沿节奏的表态。投资者该如何解读？

segments.en: I would say, yeah, and I think it's important, and we see what actually came out last night. What is critical for this store is what is the adoption doing, right? Again, the slowdown, I think, has to be in conjunction or not slowdown.
segments.zh: 我认为重要的是看采用情况。关键不在于放缓，而在于采用与发展的配合。

segments.en: Calibration rather than slowdown has to be in conjunction with adoption as well. Just to see that corporation has started to deploy AI in a much more critical way, not just kind of our users using it on a periphery for kind of improving the, improving kind of the efficiencies, but really driving the top line, driving the revenues.
segments.zh: 是校准而非放缓，且要与采用同步。企业开始以更关键的方式部署AI，不只是外围提效，而是真正驱动营收。

segments.en: And we've seen already some news in over Nordics getting an anthropic model now that is going to look to kind of provide innovation around biotech.
segments.zh: 我们已经看到北欧有企业引入Anthropic模型，用于生物科技领域的创新。

segments.en: And I think this is what we need to see. We need to see this critical adoption that is starting to lock in contracts from various these providers.
segments.zh: 这正是我们需要看到的：关键采用开始锁定与各家供应商的合同。

segments.en: That is, again, structurally is going to support the capital expenditure, and obviously the alongside is going to give a lot more room to think about security and safety around it.
segments.zh: 这在结构上会支撑资本开支，同时也为安全与保障留出更多空间。

segments.en: So I think it has to be in conjunction with development and adoption of AI. Rather than we're going to put a pause, let's think about the risks, and then we're going to put a start again, right?
segments.zh: 所以必须与AI的发展和采用同步，而不是先暂停、思考风险、再重新启动。

segments.en: I think it's going to be kind of driving forward, be more cognizant about it, but also looking at where that adoption is going, and the implication, the positive implication that has on the real economy.
segments.zh: 应继续推进，同时更清醒地关注采用走向，以及对实体经济的积极影响。

segments.en: And the opportunity set for investors given the trend is towards wider adoption.
segments.zh: 在采用范围扩大的趋势下，机会集也在扩展。
